caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an ornate design, shown at a slight angle to reveal both the front and side. The chair features a tall, rectangular backrest with curved edges and an intricately carved crest at the top, showcasing flowing, symmetrical scrollwork. Both the backrest and the seat are made of a woven material, likely cane, rendered in a light brown color, contrasting slightly with the darker brown hue of the wooden frame. The front legs of the chair are turned and connected by an elaborate stretcher adorned with additional carved scrollwork, similar in style to the crest. The rear legs are slightly angled backward and are also connected by stretchers. The chair is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or decorative elements present. The drawing uses shading to convey depth and the three-dimensional quality of the chair, emphasizing its detailed craftsmanship and ornate structure.
title: Side Chair
